blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Compensation is rarely only about money. Salary matters, of course — but research shows that, above a certain level, people choose an employer based on the whole package, not the number on the offer letter.

Modern compensation strategies combine several elements: fixed pay, variable pay such as bonuses and commissions, long-term incentives, and a range of benefits — health insurance, pension, meal vouchers, wellness programmes and flexible working. Together, these make up what HR calls the total rewards package.

The real challenge is balance. Pay too little and you lose talent. Pay far too much above the market and you create internal tensions and long-term cost pressure. Good HR teams benchmark regularly and design pay bands that are fair, transparent and sustainable — so that people join for the salary, but stay for the total experience.

items.q: According to the text, above a certain level, what do people base their choice of employer on?
options: The whole package, not just the salary
The reputation of the HR team
items.why: "people choose an employer based on the whole package, not the number on the offer letter."

items.q: Which of the following is given as an example of variable pay?
items.why: "variable pay such as bonuses and commissions" — os demais são benefícios, não remuneração variável.

items.q: What does the text say happens if a company pays far too much above the market?
options: It creates internal tensions and long-term cost pressure
It always keeps its best talent
items.why: "Pay far too much above the market and you create internal tensions and long-term cost pressure."

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: Benefits can matter as much as salary in the total package.
Benchmarking helps set sustainable pay levels.
Pay bands should be fair and transparent.
A high enough salary, on its own, is what keeps people in a company.
items.why: Inferência: o texto argumenta que 'people join for the salary, but stay for the total experience' — o salário sozinho não retém.

items.q: The final phrase "stay for the total experience" suggests that…
options: retention depends on more than pay alone
benefits are more important than fairness
items.why: Inferência: se as pessoas 'ficam' pela experiência total, a retenção vai além do salário.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte apresentando a nova estratégia de remuneração total. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Today I want to walk you through the new total rewards strategy, and how our package compares with the local market.

Let me start with the headline. On base salary, we sit slightly above the market median — not dramatically, but comfortably. Where we really stand out is on benefits. Our health cover and pension are far more generous than most of our direct competitors, and that is a deliberate choice.

Now, on variable pay we are a little behind. Our bonus scheme pays out much less often than the market, and our commission rates are slightly lower for the commercial teams. So this year we are rebalancing. We will lift variable pay closer to the benchmark, and introduce a long-term incentive for our most senior people, to help us keep them for the long run.

One principle is non-negotiable: pay equity. Every band has been reviewed, and any unexplained gaps are being closed before we roll this out. I would rather move slightly slower and get fairness right than launch something we cannot sustain.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does Charlotte describe the company's base salary compared with the market?
items.why: "On base salary, we sit slightly above the market median."

items.q: According to Charlotte, where does the company really stand out?
options: On benefits, such as health cover and pension
items.why: "Where we really stand out is on benefits… far more generous than most of our direct competitors."

items.q: What is the company doing about variable pay this year?
options: Lifting it closer to the benchmark
items.why: "We will lift variable pay closer to the benchmark."

items.q: Why is a long-term incentive being introduced for senior people?
options: To match the office pension rules
To help retain them for the long run
items.why: Inferência: 'to help us keep them for the long run' — o objetivo é retenção dos seniores.

items.q: What does Charlotte's comment about moving "slightly slower" reveal about her priorities?
options: She thinks pay equity is unimportant
She prefers to skip the benchmarking step
She wants to delay the project indefinitely
She values fairness over speed of launch
items.why: Inferência: ela prefere acertar a equidade a lançar algo insustentável — fairness acima de velocidade.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Her fixed pay stays the same each month, whatever the results." Fixed pay is…
options: the value of the benefits package
the guaranteed, regular part of the salary
items.why: Fixed pay = salário fixo: a parte garantida e regular, independente de resultados.

items.q: Choose the correct term: "Sales reps earn a base salary plus a ___ on every deal they close."
items.why: Commission = comissão: valor pago por cada venda ou negócio fechado.

items.q: "Each role sits in a defined pay band." A pay band is…
options: a salary range for a group of similar roles
items.why: Pay band = faixa salarial: o intervalo de salário definido para cargos semelhantes.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "HR ran a ___ to see how our salaries compare with the rest of the sector."
items.why: Market benchmark = referência de mercado: a comparação com o setor.

items.q: Pay equity is best described as…
options: the total cost of the benefits package
paying everyone exactly the same amount
fairness in pay, with no unexplained gaps for equal work
the share of pay that is variable
items.why: Pay equity = equidade salarial: justiça na remuneração, sem diferenças injustificadas para trabalho equivalente.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de RH e remuneração. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The board still has to sign off on the new pay structure." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the total rewards changes team by team." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva.

items.q: "The sales team pushed back on the lower commission rates." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "We promised a bonus review but never followed through." This means we…
options: failed to carry it to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "A small tweak to meal vouchers won't move the needle on retention." This means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível.
